name: Product development at the software level

checks.title: Software Safety Requirements specified
checks.description: Verify SSR exist with traceability to HSR/TSR and include ASIL and constraints.

checks.title: Software architecture and interfaces
checks.description: Confirm SW architecture defines components, interfaces, safety mechanisms, and partitioning.

checks.title: Unit design, coding standards, and static analysis
checks.description: Check unit design follows defined coding standards (e.g., MISRA) and static analysis is performed.

checks.title: Coverage evidence appropriate to ASIL
checks.description: Verify coverage metrics (e.g., MC/DC for ASIL D) are measured and justified.

checks.title: Software integration and test
checks.description: Confirm integration test strategy and results trace to SSR and demonstrate intended behavior.

checks.title: Back-to-back test for model-based development (if applicable)
checks.description: If MBD is used, verify back-to-back test between model, auto-code, and target is performed.
